info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Collateral Administration Collateral Asset Administration-spec
info.description: The Collateral Asset Administration API facilitates the management of collateral assets within the banking sector. This API allows users to create and manage collateral assets effectively, ensuring regulatory compliance and enhancing risk management practices. Typical consumers include financial institutions and asset managers who require streamlined processes for collateral tracking and administration. By leveraging this API, businesses can optimize their operational workflows and improve asset utilization.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new collateral asset within the collateral administration system. It involves submitting detailed information about the asset to be managed, ensuring that all necessary data is captured for proper handling and compliance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to perform operations related to collateral asset administration. It should contain all necessary details for the asset being managed, following the specifications outlined in the schema.

201.description: Resource created successfully, indicating the collateral asset was added.

lienStatus.description: The status of the lien on the collateral asset.
